name: Cerebral Biochip (AI Commander)
desc:
A biochip that can imprint a set of memories and habits when implanted into a human brain, allowing the recipient to rapidly obtain new skills. Such technology was tightly controlled by the Domain prior to the Collapse, and few polities of the Persean Sector still know how to program these devices, much less manufacture them from scratch.

This one is encoded with specialized knowledge in leading mixed human/AI fleets in battle. To grant yourself the AI Commander skill, apply the biochip to your ship from the drop-down menu at the top of the ship fitting window. Only the player can make use of this chip.

name: Experimental High Tech Blueprint Package
desc: A collection of blueprints for several experimental high-tech hulls. The ships appear to have been undergoing heavy design revisions when this snapshot was taken, and may exhibit significant differences compared to their finalized forms, should such blueprints still exist in the Sector.

name: Lion's Guard Blueprint Package
desc: A set of blueprints that enable heavy industry to produce the modified midline hulls employed by the Lion's Guard of the Sindrian Diktat. In theory, no copy of this blueprint set should exist outside of the most well guarded nanoforges of Askonia. In practice, you now have a copy.

name: Pipe Bomb
desc: A small improvised explosive device consisting of a fuse lit, low grade explosive charge fitted into a metal tube and capped at both ends. It was found next to an extremely blurry surveillance image of some kind, and you're not quite sure why the salvor team saw fit to bring it to you.

name: Signal Masker
desc:
A rare Domain black-ops device capable of masking the drive signature of a ship. It won't stand up to close scrutiny, but any cursory scan of a fleet running with transponders off will have even the most unusual masked ship show up as nothing more than a cargo freighter.

Installing this device on a unique ship will prevent it from being easily identified and exposing the rest of the fleet when transponders are off. Installation and removal is done via the drop down menu on top of the ship fitting window.
